context_requirements: Expression of CES1 or BCHE in the assayed cell line
Presence of a carboxylesterase-dependent substrate or lipid metabolite whose accumulation can alter transcription
Sufficient intracellular inhibitor concentration at 10 micromolar
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across cell lines that is absent in CES1/BCHE-low lines
Rescue of the transcriptional response by CES1 or BCHE overexpression
